info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Merchant Relationships Management API
info.description: The Merchant Relationships Management API facilitates the retrieval of important information regarding merchant relations associated with banking cards. It enables users to access details such as partnerships, terms, and conditions relevant to card services. This API is essential for financial institutions, payment processors, and business analysts who need to understand and manage merchant relationships effectively. By using this endpoint, developers can enhance their applications to support better decision-making and relationship management within the banking ecosystem.

get.summary: Retrieve Merchant Relations for a Specific Card
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed merchant relations for the specified card identified by its unique ID, MER-800045. It provides crucial information about the relationship between the card and affiliated merchants.
